description: This file defines a class `IfNode`, which is part of the Twig templating engine. It represents an 'if' conditional node in the abstract syntax tree (AST) used during template compilation.

classes.name: IfNode
classes.description: Represents an 'if' conditional node in the Twig template syntax, used during the compilation of Twig templates into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an IfNode with a set of test conditions and an optional else node.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Converts the IfNode into PHP code using the Twig Compiler, handling multiple 'if' and 'elseif' conditions, as well as an optional 'else' block.
